#### What's great

Using Typeahead has been very useful for typing quickly and with much less effort. I really like how the suggestions appear right where I'm writing, so I can keep my train of thought and get words out more easily. Very quick and very helpful!

#### What needs improvement

Down the line it would be great to see a cross-platform version.

#### vs Alternatives

There’s nothing else that fits my use case.

#### What's great

It definitely has helped save a lot time with typing emails, responding to Slack messages and more. It's almost weird to be typing on apps without Typeahead. It almost knows exactly what I'm thinking at times, and suggests exactly what I would type in.

#### What needs improvement

So far the updates come quickly, so there's not much yet that I can needs to be improved. It would be nice if the team decides to add a mobile app version, would love to have that incorporated at some point.
